_source: Fresenius Annual Report 2025 (fresenius_annual_report_2025.pdf, 14.1 MB, dl 2026-05-20 from fresenius.com)
_note: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA : healthcare allemand. Post-deconsolidation FMC (Medical Care) 2024. 2 business segments restants : Helios (hopitaux) + Kabi (medicaments IV + nutrition). Strategie #FutureFresenius - Rejuvenate.

kpis.explanation_fr: Plus grand segment Fresenius post-FMC : Helios = chaine hopitaux #1 Allemagne + #1 Espagne. 60% du CA Groupe. Traite 27M patients/an.
kpis.explanation_en: Largest Fresenius segment post-FMC: Helios = hospital chain #1 Germany + #1 Spain. 60% of Group sales. Treats 27M patients/year.
kpis.signal: Helios +6.4% YoY (organic +7%). EBIT 1413M EUR (vs 1319M en 2024) = margin 10.4%.

kpis.explanation_fr: Fresenius Kabi : medicaments IV genericc + biosimilars + nutrition clinique + dispositifs medicaux. 38% CA. Biosimilar denosumab Bomyntra lance Europe 2025.
kpis.explanation_en: Fresenius Kabi: IV generic drugs + biosimilars + clinical nutrition + medical devices. 38% sales. Biosimilar denosumab Bomyntra launched Europe 2025.
kpis.signal: Kabi +6% constant currency, organic +7%. EBIT 1328M EUR margin 15.4% (cible structurelle 14-17%).

kpis.explanation_fr: Fresenius est fortement europeen post-FMC : Europe = 74% du CA (vs ~50% pour secteur healthcare global). Concentration Allemagne + Espagne.
kpis.explanation_en: Fresenius is heavily Europe-centric post-FMC: Europe = 74% sales (vs ~50% for global healthcare sector). Germany + Spain concentration.
kpis.signal: Risque concentration geographique Europe. North America seulement 12% (Kabi US pharma). Asia 7% (Kabi commercial markets).

kpis.explanation_fr: Croissance organique = KPI cardinal Fresenius. 2025 = +6% constant currency / +7% organic. Strategie #FutureFresenius vise consolidation top-line.
kpis.explanation_en: Organic growth = Fresenius cardinal KPI. 2025 = +6% constant currency / +7% organic. #FutureFresenius strategy targets top-line consolidation.
kpis.signal: Organic +7% solide. FX -1% (impact USD/MXN). Pas d'effet acquisition (Vamed divested).

kpis.explanation_fr: Depenses R&D Fresenius (mainly Kabi). 624M EUR en 2025 (vs 636M 2024). Focus biosimilars + nutrition clinique innovante.
kpis.explanation_en: Fresenius R&D expenses (mainly Kabi). EUR 624M in 2025 (vs 636M 2024). Focus biosimilars + innovative clinical nutrition.
kpis.signal: R&D stable -1.9%. R&D intensity 2.8% du CA (faible vs Big Pharma 15-20% mais coherent business model Kabi generics + biosimilars).

kpis.explanation_fr: Volume patients pris en charge par les hopitaux Helios. KPI specifique sante (mesure d'impact + capacite reseau).
kpis.explanation_en: Patient volume handled by Helios hospitals. Healthcare-specific KPI (impact + network capacity measure).
kpis.signal: 27 millions patients/an. Leader hopitaux #1 Allemagne + #1 Espagne.

kpis.explanation_fr: 15 molecules biosimilars en developpement chez Kabi. Levier de croissance future + diversification vs IV generics matures.
kpis.explanation_en: 15 biosimilar molecules in development at Kabi. Future growth lever + diversification vs mature IV generics.
kpis.signal: Bomyntra (denosumab Europe) launched 2025. Pipeline solide pour expansion 2026-2030.
